trap.label: particípio perfeito
trap.wrong: Having grown up abroad, his accent is neutral.
trap.right: Having grown up abroad, he has a neutral accent.
trap.why: O particípio inicial deve ter o mesmo sujeito da oração principal. No português isso é tolerado; em inglês, seria dangling participle.

mcq.q: Having grown up abroad, ___ a neutral accent.
She ___ to notice what others overlook.

opts: Having read it, clear it was.
Having read it, it was clear.

fix.wrong: Having read it, the idea was clear.
fix.right: Having read it, she found the idea clear.

fix.wrong: Have grown up abroad, he speaks well.
fix.right: Having grown up abroad, he speaks well.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After he had grown up abroad, he spoke well.”
rewrite.answer: Having grown up abroad, he spoke well.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After she had read it, she agreed.”
